items.title: Bills star DT Oliver mourning tragic death of son
items.text: The 2-year-old son of Bills defensive tackle Ed Oliver died June 28 after he was found unresponsive in a swimming pool by family members at a residence outside Houston.

items.title: Penix fully cleared as Falcons ramp up QB1 battle
items.text: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. has been cleared to practice fully, head coach Kevin Stefanski said after Saturday's 34-6 preseason win over the Colts.

items.title: Seahawks place WR Bobo on season-ending IR
items.text: The Seahawks have placed wide receiver Jake Bobo on season-ending injured reserve with a serious knee injury and re-signed wideout Julian Hicks.

items.title: Broncos' Nix throws for TD in return from injury
items.text: Broncos quarterback Bo Nix, who underwent two offseason surgeries to repair a fractured right ankle, made his first preseason appearance Friday night, playing 14 snaps and finishing 6-of-9 passing for 76 yards and a touchdown.

items.title: 4-time Pro Bowl RB Chubb announces retirement
items.text: Veteran running back Nick Chubb, a four-time Pro Bowl selection who most recently played for the Texans, announced his retirement.

items.title: NFL reviewing WR Bateman's family violence arrest
items.text: The Ravens have informed the NFL of wide receiver Rashod Bateman's arrest in June on family violence charges, and the league said the case is under review.
